title: TFM: Generación de Datos Sintéticos para Sectores Sensibles
summary: A master's thesis (TFM) project building a generative AI framework to produce synthetic tabular data for sensitive sectors like healthcare and finance, comparing CTGAN, TVAE and Tabular Diffusion on the Diabetes 130-US Hospitals dataset to balance ML utility with GDPR anonymization goals. SDV's sdv.single_table CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, together with sdv.metadata SingleTableMetadata, are directly imported and run to train and sample the CTGAN and TVAE models.
